title: US response to China’s warnings about Coronavirus
description:
Xinhua News, a China state-run news agency,  released an animated video about the US and China’s exchange of talks regarding Coronavirus that triggered disputes over the internet on how much of it is true. 

Click on the image below to see the video:
[![Once Upon A Virus](https://i.imgur.com/CGXxIn0.png)](http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-04/30/c_139020877.htm)
question: Are the exchange of talks in the video between the US and China all true?

descriptions: Yes, all the exchange of talks in the video are true
No, at least one in the exchange of talks in the video is not true
